summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update class added in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns Update(prologue, algebra), building the prologue from q.prologue[0] before the empty-request exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; test/test_sparql_prepare.py added with tests for prepare-then-update, reuse across graphs, initNs prefixes, init bindings, direct evaluation, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty string no-op, and a no-mutation check. Caveats: no tests were run, per instructions, so everything is verified by reading only. For non-empty requests, group 0 is translated twice; the result should be identical but this is unverified by execution. The init-bindings test assumes an empty WHERE clause carries initial bindings through evalModify. Nothing was committed.
